schemes.prompt_fragment_en: Hot early-afternoon glare: high, hard sunlight from the south-west floods the long meadow grass in neutral white light with short, crisp shadows, heat haze and drifting pollen glittering in the sun; only a narrow band of shade lies at the foot of the dark-green hawthorn hedge, where the rabbit burrow is a pitch-black hole; bright, breathless, curious mood.
schemes.reason: The source gives the chase across the field to the hedge (ch001-p03) but no light. It takes the bank's heat and environment S01's sun; the black burrow mouth follows architecture (dark inside after 30 cm).
